text:
alex: Ping for reviews — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4832 ready to merge. Small naming + fmt sweep, fixes varcase and a stray trailing comma. CI is mostly green but one lint step still failing on `kvcache/encoding.go`. Need one more approval so I can land in the merge window today.

jamie: taking a look now, can you paste the failing output?

alex: sure — failing linter says:
```
encoding.go:42: trailing comma in composite literal
```
I thought `gofumpt` cleaned this, but maybe the generator emitted it. I can patch if anyone prefers me to.

maria: if it's one-line fix you can push a fixup commit. @jamie do you need me to review after? :+1:

jamie: I can review after the fix. also please run `make format` locally and re-run `tools/checks.sh` to ensure the formatter hook is satisfied.

alex: done — pushed fixup branch `4832-fmt-fix` and re-ran checks locally, all green. CI triggered: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/12345

ci-bot: build 12345 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

jamie: looks good, left one tiny nit in a comment but it's optional. approving now. :thumbsup:

maria: +1 from me as well, go ahead and merge in this slot.

alex: thanks! merging after the 10:30 deploy window opens. will squash commits.

jamie: appreciate the quick turnaround. can you add a short note to the PR description about the generator cause so we remember? small follow-up issue would be ideal.

alex: will do, filing issue #987 (generator: drop trailing commas).
